meta.promptText: India mein men ke liye konse brand ki formal shirts kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Haan — India mein **formal shirts ke liye brand choose karna ho**, toh main roughly is order mein dekhunga:

1. **Van Heusen** — ⭐ **Best overall**  
   Sharp corporate look, achhe fits aur office ke liye kaafi reliable. Current listings mein solid formal shirts ~₹1,000–₹1,300 ke aas-paas mil rahe hain. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   ### [Van Heusen Men Solid Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,029*

2. **Louis Philippe** — ⭐ **Premium choice**  
   Agar shirt thodi zyada classy/premium dikhni chahiye—meetings, presentations, senior-office look—yeh meri first choice hogi. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   ### [Louis Philippe Men Shirt]()
*₹1,724*

3. **Arrow** — **Classic formal**  
   Conservative corporate dressing ke liye bahut achha; especially white, light blue aur subtle stripes. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **Allen Solly** — **Best value / everyday office**  
   Daily office rotation ke liye good option, especially sales mein. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   ### [Allen Solly Men Solid Full Sleeves Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,294*

5. **Peter England** — **Budget-friendly**  
   Agar ₹800–₹1,500 range mein multiple shirts leni hain, toh practical choice. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   ### [Peter England Men Formal]()
*₹1,039*

### Agar main khud wardrobe bana raha hota:
- **2 × White** — Van Heusen / Louis Philippe
- **2 × Light blue** — Van Heusen / Arrow
- **1 × Light grey**
- **1 × subtle blue/white stripe**
- **1 × premium shirt** — Louis Philippe

**Sabse important:** brand se bhi zyada **fit + fabric** matter karta hai. Shirt shoulders par properly sit honi chahiye, chest par pull nahi karni chahiye, aur Indian heat ke liye cotton/cotton-rich fabric generally better rahega. [dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar aap mujhe **budget (₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000 per shirt)** aur **slim fit ya regular fit** bata do, main aapke liye **5–7 specific shirts** shortlist kar sakta hoon.
